objective: Audit and design sports and recreation mechanics. Evaluate population needs for sports and design sports building types. Design financing models: local government ownership, private commercial, privatization, and subsidized. Model sports impact on population health (life expectancy and healthy life years). Implement seasonality and climate modifiers: open-air facilities close or lose efficiency in cold winters/extreme heat; indoor facilities function year-round.
constraints: RAM protection: cargo check and cargo clippy only
Rule 1: All sports facility financing must have strict counterparty; local government ownership debits municipal budget, private model charges fees via B2C clearing
Rule 2: Sports facility costs and health bonuses must scale by average_wage and facility capacity, not flat rates
Rule 3: Physical BOM for sports facilities must be static; financial costs from market prices
Rule 4: Sports facilities must have complete lifecycle: construction, operation, privatization, closure/demolition
Rule 5: Sports capacity allocation must use market clearing (private) or pro-rata by population (public/subsidized)
Rule 13: Each sports building type must have distinct MethodSlots with physically different BOMs
Rule 14: Extend existing infrastructure/building system; do not create a parallel sports infrastructure track
Rule 15: Facility capacity, maintenance inputs, and health bonuses must scale by facility size
Rule 16: Seasonality modifiers must apply during the correct turn phase
Rule 17: Sports health impact must be visible in UI snapshots
Rule 18: Open-air vs indoor facilities must have distinct trade-offs
Rule 20: Facility utilization must clamp [0.0, 1.0] with overflow behavior
Rule 21: Public sports facilities must use cost-plus pricing with CAPEX amortization
Rule 22: Do not modify fertilizer, military, or housing modules
Rule 23: Surgically append to registries/enums.rs and production_methods_data.rs
api_contracts: state/src/registries/enums.rs — Add Commodity::SportsCapacity and BuildingType variants for sports facilities
state/src/registries/production_methods_data.rs — Add sports facility production methods with seasonality-aware BOMs
state/src/economy/labor/labor.rs — Extend life_expectancy and healthy_life_expectancy calculation to include sports/recreation access
state/src/economy/labor/labor_config.rs — Add sports_health_bonus_per_capacity_unit and climate_vulnerability parameters
state/src/infrastructure/ — Add sports facility building module with seasonality modifier logic
state/src/politics/funding.rs — Add sports facility funding models (public, private, subsidized, privatization transfer)
completion_criteria: Sports facilities have distinct types with seasonality modifiers. Open-air facilities lose efficiency in winter/extreme heat; indoor facilities operate year-round. Sports access improves life expectancy and healthy life years. All financing models use double-entry bookkeeping. UI snapshots expose sports health data. M0 conservation maintained. Iron CI/CD green.
harmonization_notes: v6 resubmission. No content changes from v5 — rejected only for re-harmonization. Updated roadmap reference to roadmap-006-001. Manager confirmed municipal budget financing is approved as-is.
